0b6e03435f.q: Why do ERP transformation projects fail according to Jonathan Rowley's experience?
0b6e03435f.a: Most projects fail because they don't define what success looks like or establish ways to measure it. Customers often just think they need a new finance system and pick one without understanding transformation outcomes. The real breakdown happens when trust is lost between people—it boils down to relationships and people rather than technology, and change management is severely underinvested in.

09f16a3a8e.q: What role does change management play in Microsoft Dynamics implementations?
09f16a3a8e.a: Change management is one of the biggest and most underinvested aspects. Partners often confuse training with change management—real change management means taking humans through the change journey, managing resistance, understanding what people are afraid of, and ensuring user adoption. If users don't adopt the system and stick to spreadsheets, the whole implementation fails regardless of technology quality.
